Expression:
VAR v = TRIM('Loan'[Loan_defaulted] & "")
RETURN
SWITCH(
    TRUE(),
    v = "1", "Default",
    v = "0", "Fully Paid",
    "Unknown"
)

VAR age_text = TRIM('Loan'[Age] & "")
VAR age_value =
    IFERROR(
        VALUE(age_text),
        BLANK()
    )
RETURN
SWITCH(
    TRUE(),
    ISBLANK(age_value), "Unknown",
    age_value < 25, "Under 25",
    age_value < 35, "25–34",
    age_value < 45, "35–44",
    age_value < 55, "45–54",
    age_value < 65, "55–64",
    "65+"
)

VAR age_text = TRIM('Loan'[Age] & "")
VAR age_value =
    IFERROR(
        VALUE(age_text),
        BLANK()
    )
RETURN
SWITCH(
    TRUE(),
    ISBLANK(age_value), 99,
    age_value < 25, 1,
    age_value < 35, 2,
    age_value < 45, 3,
    age_value < 55, 4,
    age_value < 65, 5,
    6
)

SWITCH(
    TRUE(),
    ISBLANK('Loan'[Loan_amount]), "Unknown",
    'Loan'[Loan_amount] <= 65095718, "Q1 Low loan",
    'Loan'[Loan_amount] <= 128784620, "Q2 Mid-low loan",
    'Loan'[Loan_amount] <= 219005352, "Q3 Mid-high loan",
    "Q4 High loan"
)

SWITCH(
    TRUE(),
    ISBLANK('Loan'[Bank_balance]), "Unknown",
    'Loan'[Bank_balance] <= 5781.54, "Q1 Lowest balance",
    'Loan'[Bank_balance] <= 9883.62, "Q2 Low-mid balance",
    'Loan'[Bank_balance] <= 13994.19, "Q3 Mid-high balance",
    "Q4 Highest balance"
)

SWITCH(
    TRUE(),
    ISBLANK('Loan'[Credit_history]), "Unknown",
    'Loan'[Credit_history] < 5, "<5 years",
    'Loan'[Credit_history] < 10, "5-10 years",
    'Loan'[Credit_history] < 15, "10-15 years",
    'Loan'[Credit_history] < 20, "15-20 years",
    "20+ years"
